{{Quote|Hardly seems the ''kind'' of place the Alliance should be sending its best known ''leader."<br />"''Perhaps, Captain, that's the ''reason'' they decided to ''send'' me.|Rebel Captain and Leia Organa|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 30">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]]</ref>}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] embarked on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. Leia was to contact her old history teacher, [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Arn Horada]], and use him as a starting point to establish a resistance and launch sabotage attempts against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] stopped her soon after she had made contact, forcing her to leave the planet without completing her mission. Leia was hopeful, however, that simply by revealing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was alive and well they would inspire the people of Metalorn to rebel themselves.<ref name="SW30">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]]</ref>
